description: Load this project's knowledge manual and small project map at session start.

hooks.commandWindows: $knowledgeRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Set-Location -LiteralPath $knowledgeRoot; node '.claude/hooks/knowledge-session-start.mjs'
hooks.statusMessage: Loading the knowledge manual and project map
